en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard. The front features a wide, panoramic view of a city identified as Sundsvall, as seen from Norra Stadsberget (the northern city mountain). The image captures the city's layout with numerous buildings, roads, and a river or waterfront in the background, surrounded by hills. The back of the postcard contains a section for correspondence, an address, and publisher details in Swedish.
